units.rightText: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;

units.leftText: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
units.rightText: for the truth’s sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:

units.leftText: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love. Walking in the Truth (John 8:30–47|JHN 8:30-47*)
units.rightText: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

units.leftText: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
units.rightText: I rejoice greatly that I have found certain of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.

units.leftText: And now I urge you, dear lady — not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning — that we love one another.
units.rightText: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

units.leftText: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love. Beware of Deceivers
units.rightText: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.

units.leftText: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
units.rightText: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, even they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

units.leftText: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
units.rightText: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
leftNotes: 1:8 NE and WH what you have worked for

units.leftText: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
units.rightText: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.

units.leftText: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
units.rightText: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into your house, and give him no greeting:

units.leftText: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds. Conclusion (3 John 1:13–14|3JN 13-14*)
units.rightText: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.

units.leftText: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
units.rightText: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write them with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.

units.leftText: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
units.rightText: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
